title: console: settings pages discard unsaved changes on navigation without asking
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-17** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Localization.
- **Steps:** change Default country (the bar shows "1 unsaved change"), click *Company* in the sidebar.
- **Expected:** the guard record forms have ("Discard changes? You have unsaved changes…", measured on Business Units).
- **Actual:** navigates at once; the change is gone.
- **Evidence:** [`23-config-localization-dirty.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/23-config-localization-dirty.png), [`23-config-localization-nav-away.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/23-config-localization-nav-away.png), [`09-people-business-units-discard-alert.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/09-people-business-units-discard-alert.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every settings page.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `console` settings page component.
- **Dedupe words:** unsaved changes lost settings, navigation guard.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** objectui's settings page.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 3 hits in objectui, 0 in objectstack, none on point. **New.**
